cases.sentence: Я верил, поэтому я и говорил, я сильно ___.
cases.explain: The adjective сокрушен (afflicted) is a predicate adjective in nominative case, describing the subject я.

cases.sentence: Чем воздам я Господу за всю его ___?
cases.explain: The preposition за (for) with the accusative case indicates cause or reason; доброту is the accusative form.

cases.sentence: Возьму ___ спасения и призову имя Господне.
cases.explain: The verb возьму (I will take) is transitive and takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Исполню мои обеты Господу перед всем его ___.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before, in front of) governs the instrumental case in the sense of 'in the presence of.'

cases.sentence: Дорога в глазах Господа ___ верных ему.
cases.explain: The noun смерть (death) is the predicate nominative after the linking verb, describing what is precious.

cases.sentence: Господи, истинно я ___ Твой, я слуга Твой и сын служанки Твоей.
cases.explain: The noun раб (servant) is the predicate nominative after the linking verb быть, describing the subject я.
The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Принесу тебе жертву благодарности и призову имя Господне во дворах дома Господне, посреди тебя, ___.
cases.explain: The preposition посреди (in the midst of) is followed by the prepositional case; the noun Иерусалим is in vocative address.

reading.ru: Я верил, поэтому я и говорил, я сильно сокрушен.
reading.question: What is the psalmist's emotional state in this verse?
reading.explain: The text says 'я сильно сокрушен' (I am greatly afflicted/grieved).

reading.ru: Чем воздам я Господу за всю его доброту ко мне?
reading.question: What does the psalmist recognize in this verse?
options: God's goodness toward him and his inability to repay it
The need to offer many sacrifices
reading.correct: God's goodness toward him and his inability to repay it
reading.explain: The text asks 'Чем воздам я Господу за всю его доброту' (How shall I repay the Lord for all his goodness).

reading.ru: Возьму чашу спасения и призову имя Господне, исполню мои обеты Господу перед всем его народом.
reading.question: How does the psalmist plan to respond to God's goodness?
options: By taking the cup of salvation, calling on God's name, and fulfilling his vows before all people
By performing many sacrifices and rituals
By becoming a priest in the temple
By withdrawing from public life to pray
reading.correct: By taking the cup of salvation, calling on God's name, and fulfilling his vows before all people
reading.explain: The text describes three actions: taking the cup of salvation, calling on God's name, and fulfilling vows before the people.

reading.ru: Дорога в глазах Господа смерть верных ему.
reading.question: What is precious in God's sight?
options: The death of his faithful ones
reading.correct: The death of his faithful ones
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Дорога в глазах Господа смерть верных ему' (Precious in God's sight is the death of his faithful).

reading.ru: Господи, истинно я слуга Твой, я слуга Твой и сын служанки Твоей, Ты освободил меня от цепей.
reading.question: How does the psalmist describe his relationship to God and his liberation?
options: He is God's servant, born of a servant girl, and God has freed him from bondage
He is a king appointed by God
He is a priest in God's temple
He is a prophet sent by God
reading.correct: He is God's servant, born of a servant girl, and God has freed him from bondage
reading.explain: The text states his servitude: 'я слуга Твой и сын служанки Твоей' and his liberation: 'Ты освободил меня от цепей.'

reading.ru: Принесу тебе жертву благодарности и призову имя Господне.
reading.question: What will the psalmist do to thank God?
options: Bring a thank offering and call on God's name
reading.correct: Bring a thank offering and call on God's name
reading.explain: The text says 'Принесу тебе жертву благодарности и призову имя Господне' (I will bring a thank offering and call on the Lord's name).
